data.body:
[P2] Reconcile native timestamps across partial and final collection

If partial collection occurs before `InvocationCompleted` is available, `startedAtMs` contains the fixture-observed start. Final collection then replaces it with the earlier native `StartTimestamp`. The base coordinator's `_retirement_ownership_errors` rejects any change to an original attempt's `startedAtMs`, so successfully drained work still quarantines the target. Preserve provisional timestamp provenance separately and explicitly reconcile service enrichment without treating it as invocation substitution. Add a partial-to-final regression where fixture startup follows native admission and completion history arrives during retirement.
